{{Quote|A Jedi hides on the fifth planet in the Cophrigin system on the Outer Rim.|Mara Jade|<ref name="EX" />}}
The '''Cophrigin system''' in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] within the [[Ash Worlds/Legends|Ash Worlds]] sector of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Containing at least five [[Planet/Legends|planets]], the [[Cophrigin V|fifth]] of which was a terrestrial world, the system also sported an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]]. Despite the system's relative isolation, many governments annexed the area of space over the millennia of war and peace and claimed it as their own. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] agent [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] located the mysterious [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] known as the [[The Dark Woman|Dark Woman]].<ref name="EX" />
